statement: For iid finite a.s. nonnegative nearest-neighbour edge weights on undirected Z^2, fixed n>=1 and r>0, E[T(0,n e1)^r]<infinity iff E[min(tau_1,tau_2,tau_3,tau_4)^r]<infinity; moreover P(M>t)<=P(T>t)<=n(n+2)^2(n+8)P(M>t/(n+8)).
assumptions: iid finite a.s. nonnegative edge weights
proof_or_counterexample: ATTEMPT.md section Independent check of w366-C1; four edge-disjoint deterministic routes, union bound within each route, independent product across routes, layer cake. reproduce.py checks geometry for n=1..32.
remaining_gap: No n-uniform variance exponent and no novelty finding; source Question 13 remains unsolved.

statement: For weights in [a,b] with 0<a<b on nearest-neighbour Z^d, d>=2, T(0,n e1) equals the straight n-edge sum for every configuration if n(b-a)<=2a; when a,b are essential endpoints and n(b-a)>2a, iid weights have positive probability that an (n+2)-edge detour is strictly cheaper.
assumptions: iid for the positive-probability sharpness direction
proof_or_counterexample: ATTEMPT.md section Independent check of w367-C001 and C002; path parity, extremal costs, independent disjoint-route event. reproduce.py checks equality and strict failure witnesses.
remaining_gap: Finite-size deterministic window gives no fixed-law n-to-infinity fluctuation exponent.

statement: For iid Uniform[1,1+epsilon] on Z^d with d>=2 and n epsilon<=2, Var T(0,n e1)=n epsilon^2/12. Consequently, for any theta<1 no finite C and law-independent N can make Var_F T(0,n e1)<=C Var_F(tau_e)n^theta hold for all epsilon in (0,1] and all n>=N.
proof_or_counterexample: ATTEMPT.md section Independent check of w367-C001 and C002; choose epsilon=1/n to force straight route, then normalized ratio n^(1-theta). reproduce.py gives 10 for n=1000, theta=2/3.
remaining_gap: Refutes only a law-uniform normalized bridge; does not refute original law-dependent exponent claim.

statement: For iid weights in [1,1+epsilon] on Z^2 with n epsilon<2, the unique geodesic from 0 to n e1 is the deterministic straight path in both original and independently delta-refreshed environments. Its overlap is n, Cov(T,T_delta)=(1-delta)n sigma^2 and E[(T-T_delta)^2]=2 delta n sigma^2 for delta in [0,1], where sigma^2 is edge variance.
assumptions: independent Bernoulli(delta) edge refresh with independent replacement copies
proof_or_counterexample: ATTEMPT.md Additional final-artifact checks; strict path comparison and per-edge covariance identity.
remaining_gap: No fixed-law large-n chaos estimate or exponent is settled.

statement: For iid Uniform[1,1+epsilon] edge weights with 0<epsilon<=1, K=floor(2/epsilon), theta<1, if Var(T_n)<=C Var(tau_e)n^theta for all n>=N, then either N>K or C>=K^(1-theta).
proof_or_counterexample: ATTEMPT.md Additional final-artifact checks; evaluate the hypothesized inequality at n=K when N<=K.
remaining_gap: Necessary condition only, no power bound proved.
